Synopsis:
Cerys, a tiefling scout, is now present in Last Light along with the others who evaded capture by the cultists. She has reluctantly assumed the role of leader in Zevlor's absence (assuming she hadn't already). She's exhausted by the responisibility but still capable of a little gallows humour.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_BackupLeader.json: Cerys is a tiefling scout who, with the other survivors who escaped the cultist ambush, has taken refuge in Last Light and reluctantly stepped up as leader in Zevlor’s absence. Off‑screen she and her band were recently ambushed in the cursed lands by Absolute cultists; many of her people are missing or presumed taken, and she feels guilty for leading them into danger despite having scouted ahead. The player (and possibly their companions) previously helped pull Cerys’ group out of one death‑trap, so she greets the party with weary gratitude, dry humor, and an apology. Nearby threats include an expanding Absolute presence (Moonrise Towers and its zealous guards who mind‑meld to test loyalty), which keeps everyone on edge and limits what she believes she can do for the missing.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_BackupLeader.json: Cerys is a tiefling ranger who has been out scouting the road ahead for Zevlor/Asharak, trying to find a way through the goblins on the road. She returns just after the attack on the den to discover her leader is dead, and that she'll have to take his place. She seeks player out immediately and forces a dialogue..
- PLA_KarlachRecruitment_Karlach_PostEA.json: First meeting with Karlach, future Origin/Companion. She's a fugitive, wounded and hiding from cultists who are hunting for her to drag her back to hell.The dialogue begins with a stream separating the player and Karlach, as she points a crossbow at them when they approach, holding them at bay. She's fierce, defiant, and intense. But friendly and grateful if the player helps. Shouldn't be too angry - she's in a bad situation and doesn't know who to trust, but she's also been in far worse situations. She has a sense of humour about her predicatment, no matter how bad it gets.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_BirdSender.json: This dialogue takes place in two different states. The first is after the player has successfully fought back an army of goblins that attacked the druid grove. In the second state, the goblin leaders have been killed and the tieflings in the grove are leaving. She's aware of the hard work ahead required to make things go back to normal, but she's hopeful all the same.There's an extra node to acknowledge the missing idol, if it went missing before one of those two states were triggered.
- DEN_TieflingLeader.json: In these dialogues, Zevlor reflects on what's happened (an attack of goblins at the gate, which the player helped with) and his mistrust of and bitterness towards the druids who are reluctantly hosting his people. He is exasperated, furious, but also eager to meet anyone who could help. In the same dialogue, we can also uncover that he is in fact a traitor, concerned only with getting these people through the goblins so he can trade them for his own safety later. In truth he is resentful and contemptuous of them, viewing them as weak.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Cerys: I promised you a drink the next time we met. This inn isn't what I had in mind. || [context] NodeContext: Smiling, happy to see us, but muted. She's suffered tragedy since we last saw her. (node 11)
- Cerys: I owe you an apology. You pulled my people from one death-trap, only for me to land them in another. || [context] NodeContext: Growing serious - in her mind, she messed up the chance we gave her (node 8)
- Player: How did you blunder into danger this time? (node 61)
- Cerys: ...I suppose I deserve that. || [context] NodeContext: A little stiff - primed to take offense but relaxes, accepts the insult is probably warranted (node 66)
- Cerys: I was trying to scout a path for us while you got busy carving one. But don't worry, I've had my fill of fighting since. || [context] NodeContext: wry, but ending on a somber note (node 26)
- Cerys: Aye, and more than half the others with him. (node 95)
- Cerys: We were ambushed out in the cursed lands - cultists of this Absolute. Likely we should have surrendered, but... (node 51)
- Cerys: They were toying with us. Making examples. And we'd had enough of taking it. (node 78)
- Cerys: Those of us who cut free just kept running 'til we found this place. The others... maybe the cult got them. Maybe the curse. || [context] NodeContext: Shrugging, helpless. It's not that she doesn't care what happened to them, but she's exhausted and knows there's little she can do (node 55)
- Player: What are you doing out here to begin with? You were bound for Baldur's Gate. (node 90)
- Cerys: This army of the Absolute is growing, and flowing towards Moonrise. There's worse than goblins on the roads now. || [context] NodeContext: Ominous, frustrated. They met much more resistance than she imagined (node 42)
- Cerys: I thought we might pass unnoticed along the fringes of this place. Escape the owlbear by hiding in its shadow, so to speak. (node 24)
- Cerys: You can see exactly how well that went. || [context] NodeContext: Making light of her own foolish plan. Not jokey, just tired - her failure is self-evident (node 25)
- Player: Don't lose hope. The others might still be alive. (node 22)
